chunks: What al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah, who said:
I said to Abī Ja‘far عليه السلام: If he finds water after having prayed with tayammum while the time still remains? He said: His prayer has been completed, and there is no repetition upon him.

key_terms.بِتَيَمُّمٍ: with tayammum, dry ablution performed in place of wudu (ablution) or ghusl
key_terms.وَقْتٍ: the remaining prescribed time of the prayer

ai.seo_question: If someone prays with tayammum and then finds water before the prayer time ends, must he repeat the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith states that if a person performed salat with tayammum and then found water while the prayer time still remained, the prayer already performed is valid. It establishes that repeating that salat is not obligatory upon him.
